fix(http): disable cookie jar unless it's needed

This change will disable Got.js's cookie jar functionality by default,
unless:

- A set-cookie header is seen in a response
- A default cookie is set via config.defaults.cookie
- A cookie is set for a request with request.cookie

Setting cookieJar makes Got.js attempt to read the cookie jar for
every request made, regardless of whether a cookie has actually been set or
not, which is a CPU-expensive operation.

fix(http): disable gzip by default

This change is to maintain backwards-compatibility with Request.js,
which did not set an Accept-Encoding header by default.

ci: split publish workflow

This change splits up the CircleCI workflow into two separate flows:

- When pushing any branch, it will run the test workflow, which will
  only run the test suite. By default, CircleCI runs jobs for all
  branches.
- When pushing any tag starting with `v`, it will run the publish
  workflow. It will first run tests, and if they pass it will build and
  publish the Docker image for that version, and also publish the
  package on NPM.

fix: emit stats for sleeping workers on phaseStarted event

When running a test with sleeping workers, this means that stats
agregation does not wait until timeout for all worker metrics to arrive, so:
  - Short tests are going to finish sooner (3-4s in my machine but its
    tied to number of workers)
  - Short tests are going to emit the final report properly as we geet rid
    of the race condition were report aggregation and app shutdown are competing

fix: calculate common prefix taking directory separators into account (#2106)

* fix(bom): calculate common prefix based on filepath components

The current implementation of commonPrefix treats inputs as just
strings, whereas the intention is to return common *directory*
prefix for a bunch of filenames.

Current implementation breaks on inputs such as:

['/test/acme.js', '/test/acme.yml']

returning '/test/acme.' as the result.

This change fixes that issue. The result for the input above
will now be: '/test/'.

Ref: https://github.com/artilleryio/artillery/issues/2092
